funder_origin_name: Run Run Shaw (via The Shaw Prize Foundation)
funding_share_basis: The purse is paid entirely (100%) by The Shaw Prize Foundation, the private charitable vehicle Run Run Shaw established in November 2002 with his own funds and the support of Mrs Mona Shaw; it was granted charitable status by the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department in May 2003 and both administers the prize and pays the award. No co-sponsor, government body, or corporate partner is named in the Foundation's own governance, overview, or announcement material; the related Shaw family charities (The Shaw Foundation Hong Kong, The Sir Run Run Shaw Charitable Trust) are separate entities and are not credited with the purse. Shaw's death in 2014 did not transfer the funding to any other body.
money_note: Each Shaw Prize carries US$1.2 million, raised from US$1 million in 2016, paid by The Shaw Prize Foundation; the Astronomy prize has been awarded annually since 2004.
evidence_quote: The Shaw Prize Foundation, established in November 2002, aims to honour individuals who have made distinguished contributions ... The Foundation was granted charitable status by the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department in May 2003.
